usedFor: Cloze tracks your contacts and Google Docs holds the write-up, so “Company Change” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Company Change” in Cloze, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each major company change from Cloze is written into a doc tab as a running log.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so choose add if you want a history.
